schema:
CREATE INDEX idx_books_author ON books(author_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_books_category ON books(category_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_order_lines_book ON order_lines(book_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer ON orders(customer_id);

CREATE TABLE authors (
    author_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE books (
    book_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    author_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    publisher_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    category_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    publication_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stock_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES authors(author_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (publisher_id) REFERENCES publishers(publisher_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(category_id)
);

CREATE TABLE categories (
    category_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    category_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    shelf_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    age_group TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE customers (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    loyalty_level TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE order_lines (
    line_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    book_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (book_id) REFERENCES books(book_id)
);

CREATE TABLE orders (
    order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ordered_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id)
);

CREATE TABLE publishers (
    publisher_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    publisher_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    founded_year INTEGER,
    independent INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_books_category ON books(category_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_order_lines_book ON order_lines(book_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer ON orders(customer_id);

CREATE TABLE authors (
    author_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE books (
    book_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    author_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    publisher_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    category_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    publication_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stock_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES authors(author_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (publisher_id) REFERENCES publishers(publisher_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(category_id)
);

CREATE TABLE categories (
    category_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    category_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    shelf_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    age_group TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE customers (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    loyalty_level TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE order_lines (
    line_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    book_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (book_id) REFERENCES books(book_id)
);

CREATE TABLE orders (
    order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ordered_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id)
);

CREATE TABLE publishers (
    publisher_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    publisher_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    founded_year INTEGER,
    independent INTEGER NOT NULL
);

schema:
CREATE TABLE charge_entry (
    charge_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    hire_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    paid_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (hire_id) REFERENCES hire_record(hire_id)
);

CREATE TABLE cycle_type (
    type_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    type_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    gear_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE cycle_unit (
    cycle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    type_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    serial_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    acquired_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    condition_note TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (type_id) REFERENCES cycle_type(type_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (point_id) REFERENCES pickup_point(point_id)
);

CREATE TABLE hire_record (
    hire_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    end_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    ended_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    distance_km REAL NOT NULL,
    hire_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    total_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES member_profile(member_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES cycle_unit(cycle_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (start_point_id) REFERENCES pickup_point(point_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (end_point_id) REFERENCES pickup_point(point_id)
);

CREATE TABLE member_profile (
    member_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    membership_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    home_area TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE pickup_point (
    point_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    point_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    neighborhood TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_on TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_appointments_date ON appointments(appointment_date);

CREATE INDEX idx_payments_client ON payments(client_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_procedures_appointment ON procedures(appointment_id);

CREATE TABLE animals (
    animal_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    veterinarian_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    species TEXT NOT NULL,
    breed TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sex TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (veterinarian_id) REFERENCES veterinarians(veterinarian_id)
);

CREATE TABLE appointments (
    appointment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    animal_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    veterinarian_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    appointment_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (animal_id) REFERENCES animals(animal_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (veterinarian_id) REFERENCES veterinarians(veterinarian_id)
);

CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE payments (
    payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    appointment_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    paid_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_eur REAL NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (appointment_id) REFERENCES appointments(appointment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id)
);

CREATE TABLE procedures (
    procedure_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    appointment_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    procedure_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_eur REAL NOT NULL,
    performed_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (appointment_id) REFERENCES appointments(appointment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (performed_by) REFERENCES veterinarians(veterinarian_id)
);

CREATE TABLE veterinarians (
    veterinarian_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    license_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    hired_on TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE animals (
    animal_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    veterinarian_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    species TEXT NOT NULL,
    breed TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sex TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (veterinarian_id) REFERENCES veterinarians(veterinarian_id)
);

CREATE TABLE appointments (
    appointment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    animal_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    veterinarian_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    appointment_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (animal_id) REFERENCES animals(animal_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (veterinarian_id) REFERENCES veterinarians(veterinarian_id)
);

CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE payments (
    payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    appointment_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    paid_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_eur REAL NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (appointment_id) REFERENCES appointments(appointment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id)
);

CREATE TABLE procedures (
    procedure_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    appointment_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    procedure_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_eur REAL NOT NULL,
    performed_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (appointment_id) REFERENCES appointments(appointment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (performed_by) REFERENCES veterinarians(veterinarian_id)
);

CREATE TABLE veterinarians (
    veterinarian_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    license_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    hired_on TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_interventions_equipement ON interventions(equipement_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_interventions_technicien ON interventions(technicien_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_paiements_intervention ON paiements(intervention_id);

CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom_complet TEXT NOT NULL,
    telephone TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    ville TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_inscription TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE equipements (
    equipement_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    categorie TEXT NOT NULL,
    marque TEXT NOT NULL,
    modele TEXT NOT NULL,
    numero_serie TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_achat TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id)
);

CREATE TABLE intervention_pieces (
    intervention_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    piece_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantite INTEGER NOT NULL,
    prix_facture REAL NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (intervention_id, piece_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (intervention_id) REFERENCES interventions(intervention_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (piece_id) REFERENCES pieces(piece_id)
);

CREATE TABLE interventions (
    intervention_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    equipement_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    technicien_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_depot TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_cloture TEXT,
    statut TEXT NOT NULL,
    diagnostic TEXT NOT NULL,
    main_oeuvre REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (equipement_id) REFERENCES equipements(equipement_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (technicien_id) REFERENCES techniciens(technicien_id)
);

CREATE TABLE paiements (
    paiement_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    intervention_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_paiement TEXT NOT NULL,
    montant REAL NOT NULL,
    mode_paiement TEXT NOT NULL,
    statut TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (intervention_id) REFERENCES interventions(intervention_id)
);

CREATE TABLE pieces (
    piece_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    reference_piece TEXT NOT NULL,
    designation TEXT NOT NULL,
    categorie TEXT NOT NULL,
    prix_unitaire REAL NOT NULL,
    stock INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE techniciens (
    technicien_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom_complet TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialite TEXT NOT NULL,
    niveau TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_embauche TEXT NOT NULL
);

);

    diagnostic TEXT NOT NULL,
    main_oeuvre REAL NOT NULL,

    FOREIGN KEY (technicien_id) REFERENCES techniciens(technicien_id)
);

CREATE TABLE paiements (
    paiement_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    intervention_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_paiement TEXT NOT NULL,
    montant REAL NOT NULL,
    mode_paiement TEXT NOT NULL,
    statut TEXT NOT NULL,

);

    piece_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

    designation TEXT NOT NULL,

CREATE INDEX idx_enrollments_session ON enrollments(session_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_course ON sessions(course_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_trainer ON sessions(trainer_id);

CREATE TABLE courses (
    course_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    course_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    domain TEXT NOT NULL,
    level TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_hours INTEGER NOT NULL,
    price_eur INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE enrollments (
    enrollment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    learner_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    enrollment_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    attendance_rate INTEGER NOT NULL,
    final_score INTEGER,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (learner_id) REFERENCES learners(learner_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(session_id)
);

CREATE TABLE learners (
    learner_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    registration_date TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE sessions (
    session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    course_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    trainer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    room_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    delivery_mode TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES courses(course_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (trainer_id) REFERENCES trainers(trainer_id)
);

CREATE TABLE trainers (
    trainer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate INTEGER NOT NULL
);

question: Combien d’offres y a-t-il dans chaque catégorie parmi les offres végétariennes et actives ?
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM offerings WHERE vegetarian = 1 AND active = 1 GROUP BY category

question: Quel est le nombre d’offres regroupées par prix unitaire, qui sont actives et ne relèvent pas de la catégorie « dessert » ?
sql: SELECT unit_price, COUNT(*) FROM offerings WHERE active = 1 AND category != 'dessert' GROUP BY unit_price

question: Combien d’offres sont regroupées selon leur caractère végétarien, avec un prix supérieur à 10 et une catégorie égale à « plat » ?
sql: SELECT vegetarian, COUNT(*) FROM offerings WHERE unit_price > 10 AND category = 'plat' GROUP BY vegetarian

question: Combien de reçus correspondent à chaque mode de paiement, lorsque le sous-total dépasse 50 et que le pourboire est positif ?
sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) FROM receipts WHERE subtotal > 50 AND tip_amount > 0 GROUP BY payment_method

question: Quel est le nombre de reçus pour chaque date d’émission, dont le mode de paiement n’est pas « cash » et le montant payé est au moins égal à 30 ?
sql: SELECT issued_at, COUNT(*) FROM receipts WHERE payment_method != 'cash' AND paid_amount >= 30 GROUP BY issued_at

question: Combien de reçus sont associés à chaque ticket, avec un sous-total d’au moins 20 et un paiement effectué par carte ?
sql: SELECT ticket_id, COUNT(*) FROM receipts WHERE subtotal >= 20 AND payment_method = 'card' GROUP BY ticket_id

question: Quel est le nombre de sites dans chaque ville, parmi ceux ayant plus de 50 places et ouverts avant 2020 ?
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM service_sites WHERE seating_capacity > 50 AND opening_year < 2020 GROUP BY city

question: Combien de sites sont regroupés par quartier, lorsque leur ville est « Lyon » et leur capacité est d’au moins 30 places ?
sql: SELECT neighborhood, COUNT(*) FROM service_sites WHERE city = 'Lyon' AND seating_capacity >= 30 GROUP BY neighborhood

question: Combien de tickets possèdent chaque statut, lorsqu’ils proviennent du canal « web » et ont été ouverts depuis 2023 ?
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM service_tickets WHERE channel = 'web' AND opened_at >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY status

question: Quel est le nombre de tickets pour chaque canal, dont le statut n’est pas « closed » et dont l’identifiant de site est supérieur à 2 ?
sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) FROM service_tickets WHERE status != 'closed' AND site_id > 2 GROUP BY channel

question: Combien de tickets sont regroupés par site, avec un identifiant client supérieur à 100 et le statut « open » ?
sql: SELECT site_id, COUNT(*) FROM service_tickets WHERE customer_id > 100 AND status = 'open' GROUP BY site_id

question: Quel est le nombre de lignes de ticket pour chaque offre, lorsque la quantité dépasse 2 et que le prix unitaire est inférieur à 25 ?
sql: SELECT offering_id, COUNT(*) FROM ticket_lines WHERE quantity > 2 AND unit_price < 25 GROUP BY offering_id

question: Combien de lignes sont associées à chaque ticket, avec une quantité d’au moins 1 et un prix unitaire supérieur à 5 ?
sql: SELECT ticket_id, COUNT(*) FROM ticket_lines WHERE quantity >= 1 AND unit_price > 5 GROUP BY ticket_id

question: Combien de clients sont regroupés par adresse électronique, ayant rejoint le service avant 2021 et appartenant au niveau « silver » ?
sql: SELECT email, COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE joined_on < '2021-01-01' AND loyalty_level = 'silver' GROUP BY email

question: Quel est le nombre d’offres pour chaque catégorie, dont le prix unitaire est inférieur ou égal à 15 et qui sont actuellement actives ?
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM offerings WHERE unit_price <= 15 AND active = 1 GROUP BY category

question: Combien de reçus sont regroupés par montant payé, lorsque le sous-total est supérieur à 100 et le paiement n’est pas effectué par chèque ?
sql: SELECT paid_amount, COUNT(*) FROM receipts WHERE subtotal > 100 AND payment_method != 'check' GROUP BY paid_amount

question: Quel est le nombre de sites pour chaque année d’ouverture, situés dans la ville « Paris » et disposant d’au moins 20 places ?
sql: SELECT opening_year, COUNT(*) FROM service_sites WHERE city = 'Paris' AND seating_capacity >= 20 GROUP BY opening_year

question: Combien de tickets sont regroupés par date d’ouverture, avec le statut « pending » et un identifiant client inférieur à 500 ?
sql: SELECT opened_at, COUNT(*) FROM service_tickets WHERE status = 'pending' AND customer_id < 500 GROUP BY opened_at

question: Quel est le nombre de lignes pour chaque quantité, dont l’identifiant d’offre est supérieur à 10 et le prix unitaire est au moins égal à 8 ?
sql: SELECT quantity, COUNT(*) FROM ticket_lines WHERE offering_id > 10 AND unit_price >= 8 GROUP BY quantity

question: Combien de sites sont regroupés par capacité d’accueil, lorsque l’année d’ouverture est supérieure à 2015 et que le quartier n’est pas « Centre » ?
sql: SELECT seating_capacity, COUNT(*) FROM service_sites WHERE opening_year > 2015 AND neighborhood != 'Centre' GROUP BY seating_capacity

schema:
CREATE INDEX idx_booking_athlete ON booking(athlete_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_booking_session ON booking(session_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_group_coach ON sport_group(coach_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_session_group_date ON training_session(group_id, session_date);

CREATE TABLE athlete (
    athlete_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    skill_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (active IN (0, 1))
);

CREATE TABLE booking (
    booking_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    athlete_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    booked_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    performance_score INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (athlete_id) REFERENCES athlete(athlete_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES training_session(session_id)
);

CREATE TABLE coach (
    coach_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    hired_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE sport_group (
    group_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    group_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    sport TEXT NOT NULL,
    age_category TEXT NOT NULL,
    coach_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    max_members INTEGER NOT NULL,
    monthly_fee INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (coach_id) REFERENCES coach(coach_id)
);

CREATE TABLE training_session (
    session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    group_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    session_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    location TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES sport_group(group_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_booking_dates ON stay_booking(arrival_date, departure_date);

CREATE INDEX idx_pontoon_marina ON pontoon(marina_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_service_marina_status ON service_order(marina_id, service_status);

CREATE TABLE boat (
    boat_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    home_marina_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    boat_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    length_m REAL NOT NULL,
    draft_m REAL NOT NULL,
    built_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES member(member_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (home_marina_id) REFERENCES marina(marina_id)
);

CREATE TABLE marina (
    marina_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    town TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE member (
    member_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    phone TEXT,
    registration_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    membership_level TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE pontoon (
    pontoon_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    marina_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    code TEXT NOT NULL,
    water_depth REAL NOT NULL,
    berth_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (marina_id) REFERENCES marina(marina_id)
);

CREATE TABLE service_order (
    service_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    boat_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    marina_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    service_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    opened_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    completed_date TEXT,
    cost REAL NOT NULL,
    service_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (boat_id) REFERENCES boat(boat_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (marina_id) REFERENCES marina(marina_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES member(member_id)
);

CREATE TABLE stay_booking (
    booking_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    boat_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    pontoon_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    arrival_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    departure_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    total_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (boat_id) REFERENCES boat(boat_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (pontoon_id) REFERENCES pontoon(pontoon_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES member(member_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_payments_claim ON payments(claim_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_policies_client ON policies(client_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_policies_product ON policies(product_id);

CREATE TABLE agents (
    agent_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    office_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE claims (
    claim_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    handler_agent_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    incident_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    reported_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    claim_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimed_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    approved_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    claim_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (policy_id) REFERENCES policies(policy_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (handler_agent_id) REFERENCES agents(agent_id)
);

CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    signup_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    risk_segment TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE payments (
    payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    claim_id INTEGER,
    payment_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (policy_id) REFERENCES policies(policy_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (claim_id) REFERENCES claims(claim_id)
);

CREATE TABLE policies (
    policy_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agent_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    policy_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    premium REAL NOT NULL,
    policy_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (agent_id) REFERENCES agents(agent_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id)
);

CREATE TABLE products (
    product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    product_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    annual_fee REAL NOT NULL,
    coverage_limit REAL NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_vehicles_customer ON vehicles(customer_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_work_order_lines_order ON work_order_lines(work_order_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_work_orders_mechanic ON work_orders(mechanic_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_work_orders_vehicle ON work_orders(vehicle_id);

CREATE TABLE customers (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    customer_since TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE mechanics (
    mechanic_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE payments (
    payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    work_order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    paid_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    method TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (work_order_id) REFERENCES work_orders(work_order_id)
);

CREATE TABLE vehicles (
    vehicle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    registration_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    make TEXT NOT NULL,
    model TEXT NOT NULL,
    production_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    fuel_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    mileage INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id)
);

CREATE TABLE work_order_lines (
    line_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    work_order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    line_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity REAL NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (work_order_id) REFERENCES work_orders(work_order_id)
);

CREATE TABLE work_orders (
    work_order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    vehicle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    mechanic_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    closed_on TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    service_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    estimated_total REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicles(vehicle_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (mechanic_id) REFERENCES mechanics(mechanic_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_conferences_dates ON conferences(start_date, end_date);

CREATE INDEX idx_registrations_conference ON registrations(conference_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_conference_date ON sessions(conference_id, session_date);

CREATE TABLE conferences (
    conference_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    venue_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    conference_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    theme TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (venue_id) REFERENCES venues(venue_id)
);

CREATE TABLE people (
    person_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    organization TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE registrations (
    registration_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    conference_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    person_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    registration_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    ticket_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_paid REAL NOT NULL,
    registration_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (conference_id) REFERENCES conferences(conference_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES people(person_id)
);

CREATE TABLE session_attendance (
    attendance_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    person_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    check_in_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    feedback_score INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(session_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES people(person_id)
);

CREATE TABLE sessions (
    session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    conference_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    venue_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    session_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (conference_id) REFERENCES conferences(conference_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (venue_id) REFERENCES venues(venue_id)
);

CREATE TABLE venues (
    venue_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    venue_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_roster_team_game ON team_roster(team_id, game_id);

CREATE TABLE esports_team (
    team_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    team_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    team_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    home_region TEXT NOT NULL,
    founded_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    active_flag INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE event_series (
    event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    event_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    season_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tier TEXT NOT NULL,
    prize_pool_eur INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE game_title (
    game_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    game_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    genre TEXT NOT NULL,
    publisher TEXT NOT NULL,
    platform TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE match_record (
    match_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    game_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    home_team_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    away_team_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    winner_team_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    played_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    stage_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    home_score INTEGER NOT NULL,
    away_score INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES event_series(event_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (game_id) REFERENCES game_title(game_id),

    FOREIGN KEY (away_team_id) REFERENCES esports_team(team_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (winner_team_id) REFERENCES esports_team(team_id)
);

    player_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    handle TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    country_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    rating INTEGER NOT NULL
);

    roster_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    team_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    player_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    game_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    role_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    left_on TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES esports_team(team_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (player_id) REFERENCES player_profile(player_id),

);

question: Pour chaque nom de client, combien de réservations ont moins de 5 places et un montant payé inférieur à 100 euros ?
sql: SELECT customer_name, COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE seats_reserved < 5 AND amount_paid < 100 GROUP BY customer_name

question: Pour chaque rôle, combien d’associations d’artistes ont un ordre de facturation égal à 1 et un identifiant d’artiste supérieur à 20 ?

question: Pour chaque ordre de facturation, combien d’associations concernent le rôle « principal » et la session numéro 10 ?
sql: SELECT billing_order, COUNT(*) FROM session_artists WHERE role_name = 'principal' AND session_id = 10 GROUP BY billing_order

question: Pour chaque statut de session, combien de séances commencent à partir du 1er janvier 2024 et ont un prix de base supérieur à 30 ?

question: Pour chaque production, combien de séances ont un prix de base inférieur ou égal à 25 et se déroulent dans l’auditorium numéro 4 ?

question: Pour chaque ville, combien de lieux ont ouvert avant 2000 et possèdent un identifiant différent de 5 ?

question: Pour chaque année d’ouverture, combien de lieux se trouvent à Lyon et ont un identifiant supérieur à 2 ?
sql: SELECT opened_year, COUNT(*) FROM venues WHERE city = 'Lyon' AND venue_id > 2 GROUP BY opened_year

question: Pour chaque niveau d’accessibilité, combien d’auditoriums ont exactement 300 places et appartiennent au lieu numéro 7 ?
sql: SELECT accessibility_level, COUNT(*) FROM auditoriums WHERE seat_count = 300 AND venue_id = 7 GROUP BY accessibility_level

question: Pour chaque spécialité, combien d’artistes viennent d’une ville différente de Marseille et ont un identifiant inférieur à 50 ?
sql: SELECT specialty, COUNT(*) FROM artists WHERE home_city != 'Marseille' AND artist_id < 50 GROUP BY specialty

question: Pour chaque catégorie, combien de productions ont une durée d’au moins 60 minutes et un âge minimum égal à 16 ans ?
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM productions WHERE duration_minutes >= 60 AND minimum_age = 16 GROUP BY category

question: Pour chaque statut de paiement, combien de réservations ont été effectuées avant le 1er juin 2023 et concernent au moins 4 places ?

question: Pour chaque rôle, combien d’associations d’artistes ont un ordre de facturation inférieur à 3 et concernent la session numéro 8 ?
sql: SELECT role_name, COUNT(*) FROM session_artists WHERE billing_order < 3 AND session_id = 8 GROUP BY role_name

question: Pour chaque statut de session, combien de séances commencent avant le 1er janvier 2023 et ont un prix de base d’au moins 20 ?
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM sessions WHERE starts_at < '2023-01-01' AND base_price >= 20 GROUP BY status

question: Pour chaque ville, combien de lieux ont ouvert à partir de 2010 et ont un nom différent de « Grand Théâtre » ?

schema:
CREATE INDEX idx_pay_batches_cycle ON pay_batches(cycle_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_pay_batches_employee ON pay_batches(employee_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_pay_entries_batch ON pay_entries(batch_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_staff_benefits_employee ON staff_benefits(employee_id);

CREATE TABLE employee_roster (
    employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    department_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    job_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    contract_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    base_monthly_salary REAL NOT NULL,
    active_flag INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE pay_batches (
    batch_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    gross_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    tax_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    social_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    net_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    processed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    batch_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES employee_roster(employee_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES salary_cycles(cycle_id)
);

CREATE TABLE pay_entries (
    entry_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    entry_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    entry_label TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    taxable_flag INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES pay_batches(batch_id)
);

CREATE TABLE salary_cycles (
    cycle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_label TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    period_start TEXT NOT NULL,
    period_end TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    cycle_status TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE staff_benefits (
    benefit_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    benefit_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    monthly_cost REAL NOT NULL,
    employer_share REAL NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    benefit_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES employee_roster(employee_id)
);

    PRIMARY KEY (beer_id, ingredient_id),

    beer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

    style TEXT NOT NULL,
    abv REAL NOT NULL,
    ibu INTEGER NOT NULL,
    launch_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    retail_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES brewery_sites(site_id)
);

CREATE TABLE brewery_sites (
    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    catalog_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    site_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    capacity_liters INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ingredients (
    ingredient_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    ingredient_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    ingredient_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    origin_country TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_cost REAL NOT NULL,
    organic_flag INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE taproom_sales (
    sale_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    beer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sale_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    format TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    customer_segment TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES brewery_sites(site_id),

);

schema:
CREATE INDEX idx_booking_ride ON booking(ride_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_payment_booking ON payment(booking_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_rating_target ON rating(target_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_ride_driver_date ON ride(driver_id, departure_at);

CREATE INDEX idx_vehicle_owner ON vehicle(owner_id);

CREATE TABLE booking (
    booking_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    ride_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    passenger_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    booked_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    seats_booked INTEGER NOT NULL,
    booking_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (booking_status IN ('confirmed','completed','cancelled')),
    FOREIGN KEY (ride_id) REFERENCES ride(ride_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (passenger_id) REFERENCES member(member_id)
);

CREATE TABLE member (
    member_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    member_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (member_role IN ('driver','passenger','both')),
    trust_score REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE payment (
    payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    booking_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
    paid_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (payment_status IN ('paid','refunded','pending')),
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (payment_method IN ('card','wallet','bank_transfer')),
    FOREIGN KEY (booking_id) REFERENCES booking(booking_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (payer_id) REFERENCES member(member_id)
);

CREATE TABLE rating (
    rating_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    booking_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    author_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    target_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    score INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (score BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    comment TEXT NOT NULL,
    rated_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (booking_id) REFERENCES booking(booking_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES member(member_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (target_id) REFERENCES member(member_id)

schema:
CREATE INDEX idx_animal_client ON animal(client_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_prescription_medication ON prescription(medication_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_prescription_visit ON prescription(visit_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_visit_animal ON visit(animal_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_visit_veterinarian ON visit(veterinarian_id);

CREATE TABLE animal (
    animal_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    species TEXT NOT NULL,
    breed TEXT NOT NULL,
    sex TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    weight_kg REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES client(client_id)
);

CREATE TABLE client (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT UNIQUE,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE medication (
    medication_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    active_ingredient TEXT NOT NULL,
    form TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    stock_units INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE prescription (
    prescription_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    partner_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    partnership_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    contribution_eur INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES festival_cycle(cycle_id)
);

    cycle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    edition_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    opening_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    closing_date TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE pass_order (
    order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    pass_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    buyer_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_eur INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sales_channel TEXT NOT NULL,
    ordered_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES festival_cycle(cycle_id)
);

CREATE TABLE performer (
    performer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    stage_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    music_style TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    booking_fee INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE set_listing (
    set_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    venue_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    performer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    set_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    attendance_estimate INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES festival_cycle(cycle_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (venue_id) REFERENCES venue_slot(venue_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (performer_id) REFERENCES performer(performer_id)
);

CREATE TABLE venue_slot (
    venue_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    venue_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,

    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES festival_cycle(cycle_id)
);

    partner_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    partner_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    partnership_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    contribution_eur INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES festival_cycle(cycle_id)
);

CREATE TABLE festival_cycle (
    cycle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    edition_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    opening_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    closing_date TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE pass_order (
    order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    pass_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    buyer_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_eur INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sales_channel TEXT NOT NULL,
    ordered_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES festival_cycle(cycle_id)
);

CREATE TABLE performer (
    performer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    stage_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    music_style TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    booking_fee INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE set_listing (
    set_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    venue_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    performer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    set_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    attendance_estimate INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES festival_cycle(cycle_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (venue_id) REFERENCES venue_slot(venue_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (performer_id) REFERENCES performer(performer_id)
);

CREATE TABLE venue_slot (
    venue_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    venue_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    covered INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES festival_cycle(cycle_id)
);

);

    ville TEXT NOT NULL,
    type_client TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_inscription TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE famille (
    famille_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom TEXT NOT NULL,
    rayon TEXT NOT NULL,
    taux_tva REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE fournisseur (
    fournisseur_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    raison_sociale TEXT NOT NULL,
    ville TEXT NOT NULL,
    pays TEXT NOT NULL,
    delai_jours INTEGER NOT NULL,
    evaluation REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ligne_ticket (
    ligne_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    ticket_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    article_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantite INTEGER NOT NULL,
    prix_unitaire REAL NOT NULL,
    remise REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (ticket_id) REFERENCES ticket(ticket_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (article_id) REFERENCES article(article_id)
);

CREATE TABLE magasin (
    magasin_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom TEXT NOT NULL,
    ville TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    surface_m2 INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ouvert_depuis INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE offre_fournisseur (
    offre_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    fournisseur_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    article_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    prix_achat REAL NOT NULL,
    minimum_commande INTEGER NOT NULL,
    disponible INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (fournisseur_id) REFERENCES fournisseur(fournisseur_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (article_id) REFERENCES article(article_id),
    UNIQUE (fournisseur_id, article_id)
);

CREATE TABLE ticket (
    ticket_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    magasin_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    client_id INTEGER,
    date_vente TEXT NOT NULL,
    mode_paiement TEXT NOT NULL,
    statut TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (magasin_id) REFERENCES magasin(magasin_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES client(client_id)
);

CREATE TABLE travelers (

);

    completed_on TEXT,
    milestone_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(project_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (owner_employee_id) REFERENCES employees(employee_id)
);

    assignment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    assignment_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    allocation_percent INTEGER NOT NULL,
    assigned_from TEXT NOT NULL,
    assigned_to TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(project_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES employees(employee_id)
);

    project_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,

);

CREATE INDEX idx_walking_route_zone ON walking_route(zone_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_wildlife_record_route ON wildlife_record(route_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_wildlife_record_species ON wildlife_record(species_id);

CREATE TABLE habitat_zone (
    zone_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    park_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    zone_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    habitat_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    altitude_min_m INTEGER NOT NULL,
    altitude_max_m INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (park_id) REFERENCES natural_park(park_id)
);

CREATE TABLE natural_park (
    park_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    park_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    region_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    area_km2 REAL NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    protection_level TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE species_catalog (
    species_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    scientific_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    common_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    conservation_status TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE walking_route (
    route_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    route_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    distance_km REAL NOT NULL,
    difficulty TEXT NOT NULL,
    elevation_gain_m INTEGER NOT NULL,
    open_months TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (zone_id) REFERENCES habitat_zone(zone_id)
);

CREATE TABLE wildlife_record (
    record_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    route_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    species_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    observed_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    evidence_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    observer_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (route_id) REFERENCES walking_route(route_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (species_id) REFERENCES species_catalog(species_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_walking_route_zone ON walking_route(zone_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_wildlife_record_route ON wildlife_record(route_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_wildlife_record_species ON wildlife_record(species_id);

CREATE TABLE habitat_zone (
    zone_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    park_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    zone_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    habitat_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    altitude_min_m INTEGER NOT NULL,
    altitude_max_m INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (park_id) REFERENCES natural_park(park_id)
);

CREATE TABLE natural_park (
    park_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    park_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    region_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    area_km2 REAL NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    protection_level TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE species_catalog (
    species_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    scientific_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    common_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    conservation_status TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE walking_route (
    route_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    route_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    distance_km REAL NOT NULL,
    difficulty TEXT NOT NULL,
    elevation_gain_m INTEGER NOT NULL,
    open_months TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (zone_id) REFERENCES habitat_zone(zone_id)
);

CREATE TABLE wildlife_record (
    record_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    route_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    species_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    observed_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    evidence_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    observer_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (route_id) REFERENCES walking_route(route_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (species_id) REFERENCES species_catalog(species_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_contributor_attendee ON agenda_contributor(attendee_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_enrollment_summit ON enrollment(summit_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_summit_dates ON summit(start_date, end_date);

CREATE TABLE agenda_contributor (
    agenda_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    attendee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    contribution_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    speaking_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (agenda_item_id, attendee_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (agenda_item_id) REFERENCES agenda_item(agenda_item_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (attendee_id) REFERENCES attendee(attendee_id)
);

CREATE TABLE agenda_item (
    agenda_item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    summit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    item_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    starts_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    room_label TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (summit_id) REFERENCES summit(summit_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES site(site_id)
);

CREATE TABLE attendee (
    attendee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    organization TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE enrollment (
    enrollment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    summit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    attendee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    registered_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    ticket_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_eur INTEGER NOT NULL,
    attendance_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (summit_id) REFERENCES summit(summit_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (attendee_id) REFERENCES attendee(attendee_id)
);

CREATE TABLE site (
    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    accessibility_level TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE summit (
    summit_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    summit_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    theme TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    budget_eur INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES site(site_id)
);

sql: SELECT site_name FROM site WHERE site_id IN (SELECT site_id FROM site)

CREATE INDEX idx_athletes_club ON athletes(club_id);

CREATE TABLE athletes (
    athlete_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    club_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    gamer_tag TEXT NOT NULL,
    real_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    monthly_salary INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (club_id) REFERENCES clubs(club_id)
);

CREATE TABLE clubs (
    club_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    club_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    home_region TEXT NOT NULL,
    founded_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sponsor_tier INTEGER NOT NULL,
    active_flag INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE contracts (
    contract_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    athlete_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    club_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    signed_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    contract_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    buyout_value INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (athlete_id) REFERENCES athletes(athlete_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (club_id) REFERENCES clubs(club_id)
);

CREATE TABLE events (
    event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    game_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    prize_pool INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE fixture_entries (
    fixture_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    club_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    side_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    rounds_won INTEGER NOT NULL,
    player_rating REAL NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (fixture_id, club_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (fixture_id) REFERENCES fixtures(fixture_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (club_id) REFERENCES clubs(club_id)
);

CREATE TABLE fixtures (
    fixture_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    home_club_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    away_club_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    scheduled_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    best_of INTEGER NOT NULL,
    winner_club_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(event_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (home_club_id) REFERENCES clubs(club_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (away_club_id) REFERENCES clubs(club_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (winner_club_id) REFERENCES clubs(club_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_commandes_client ON commandes_atelier(client_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_commandes_employe ON commandes_atelier(employe_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_paiements_commande ON paiements_atelier(commande_id);

CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    telephone TEXT,
    ville TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_inscription TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE commande_services (
    commande_service_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    commande_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    service_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantite INTEGER NOT NULL,
    prix_applique REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (commande_id) REFERENCES commandes_atelier(commande_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services_couture(service_id)
);

CREATE TABLE commandes_atelier (
    commande_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    employe_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_depot TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_livraison_prevue TEXT NOT NULL,
    statut TEXT NOT NULL,
    total_estime REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (employe_id) REFERENCES employes(employe_id)
);

CREATE TABLE employes (
    employe_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialite TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_embauche TEXT NOT NULL,
    taux_horaire REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE paiements_atelier (
    paiement_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    commande_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_paiement TEXT NOT NULL,
    montant REAL NOT NULL,
    mode_paiement TEXT NOT NULL,
    statut TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (commande_id) REFERENCES commandes_atelier(commande_id)
);

CREATE TABLE services_couture (
    service_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    libelle TEXT NOT NULL,
    categorie TEXT NOT NULL,
    prix_unitaire REAL NOT NULL,
    duree_jours INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    telephone TEXT,
    ville TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_inscription TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE commande_services (
    commande_service_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    commande_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    service_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantite INTEGER NOT NULL,
    prix_applique REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (commande_id) REFERENCES commandes_atelier(commande_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services_couture(service_id)
);

CREATE TABLE commandes_atelier (
    commande_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    employe_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_depot TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_livraison_prevue TEXT NOT NULL,
    statut TEXT NOT NULL,
    total_estime REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (employe_id) REFERENCES employes(employe_id)
);

CREATE TABLE employes (
    employe_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialite TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_embauche TEXT NOT NULL,
    taux_horaire REAL NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE paiements_atelier (
    paiement_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    commande_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_paiement TEXT NOT NULL,
    montant REAL NOT NULL,
    mode_paiement TEXT NOT NULL,
    statut TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (commande_id) REFERENCES commandes_atelier(commande_id)
);

CREATE TABLE services_couture (
    service_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    libelle TEXT NOT NULL,
    categorie TEXT NOT NULL,
    prix_unitaire REAL NOT NULL,
    duree_jours INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_assignments_agent ON assignments(agent_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_missions_date ON missions(mission_date);

CREATE INDEX idx_sites_client ON sites(client_id);

CREATE TABLE agents (
    agent_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    certification TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE assignments (
    mission_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agent_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL,
    hours_worked REAL NOT NULL,
    attendance TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (mission_id, agent_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (mission_id) REFERENCES missions(mission_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (agent_id) REFERENCES agents(agent_id)
);

CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    company_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    sector TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    contract_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    active_since TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE missions (
    mission_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    mission_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    shift_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    required_agents INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    supervisor_agent_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES sites(site_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (supervisor_agent_id) REFERENCES agents(agent_id)
);

CREATE TABLE sites (
    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    site_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    risk_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    access_notes TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id)
);
